derivation: from H6901 (קָבַל) in the sense of opposite (see H6904 (קֹבֶל));
def: the presence, i.e. (adverbially) in front of

occurrences.text: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
